audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read the placeholder 'Skill' while content win[N] already says Lux for stages 0-5 and Seraphine for stage 6 — the two layers contradict.
audit.why: Light Binding (1175 range) out-ranges Seraphine's Q (900) and her E Lucent Singularity out-ranges Seraphine's E, so Lux wins the poke war through first item; Seraphine's Encore AoE charm flips it once she has 2+ items.
audit.corrected: phases[0-5].side = Lux, phases[6].side = Seraphine, with matching .why and adjusted .rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Light Binding as matchup-defining but contains no cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Real cooldowns make the sequencing advice concrete and let the reader count seconds.
audit.corrected: Added Light Binding's 10s CD, Beat Drop's 9-11s CD, and the ult's 160/140/120s CD from the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Prismatic Barrier (Lux W, shield) and the Illumination auto-reset tell were flagged in missingInteractions but never mentioned anywhere in the page.
audit.why: Her W absorbs Seraphine's burst window, and her P auto-attack reset is the visible wind-up cue before her combo lands.
audit.corrected: Folded shield-absorbs-burst into loading, and the auto-reset tell into dosFull[1].d.
